data_fields.name: task_slots_per_thema
data_fields.donor_constant: rite + up to 7 tasks (8 packed slots); more than 7 only warns

data_fields.name: slot_state_values
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 hidden, 1 shown, 2 done (2 bits per slot)

data_fields.name: thema_reward
data_fields.donor_constant: reward text and reward sheet, shown at state 2 only

data_fields.name: album_reward_brick
data_fields.donor_constant: reward brick at album state 2 (honorific title)

best_idea: A codex where each entry is a theme with a rite and up to seven task slots, packed as 2-bit states, revealed by a mission or action, completed by mission success, and rewarded per theme and per album.
decision_why: Keep the album, thema and slot model, the hidden/shown/done states, mission-driven updates, rite-gated completion and completion-only rewards. Use stable ids, refuse out-of-range slots, return errors instead of asserting. Reject position-keyed storage and the unchecked task count.
acceptance: A server test: one album, two themas; finishing a thema's rite and tasks makes it done and shows its reward text once; when both themas are done the album shows its reward brick; an eight-task sheet fails to load; renumbering a thema leaves progress on the same legend.
